tha-ap373:1.1: Mandārapupphiyavaggo sattatiṃso. [368. Bodhivandaka.] Pāṭaliṃ haritaṃ disvā pādapaṃ dharaṇīruhaṃ / ekaṃsam añjaliṃ katvā avandiṃ pāṭalim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap373:2.1: Añjaliṃ paggahetvāna garuṃ katvāna mānasaṃ / antosuddhaṃ bahiṃ suddhaṃ suvimuttam anāsavaṃ // //
tha-ap373:3.1: Vipassiṃ lokamahitaṃ karuṇāñāṇasāgaraṃ / sammukhā viya *sam*buddham avandiṃ pāṭalim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap373:4.1: Ekanavut' ito kappe yaṃ bodhim abhivand' ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi vandanāya idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap373:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Bodhivandako thero i. g. a-ti.
